title: MulRobBench: A Decision-Level Benchmark for Safe and Security-Policy-Compliant Multimodal UAV Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.23870v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In IoT-enabled smart-city settings, Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are evolving from passive sensing platforms into cyber-physical decision makers that must respect operational rules under degraded observations and ambiguous language. Existing UAV and multimodal benchmarks cover aerial perception, navigation, collaboration, and task reasoning, but rarely test whether physical evidence, protocol constraints, and action risk stay coupled at critical decisions. We introduce MulRobBench, an offline, protocol-conditioned benchmark for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) UAV agents that links real UAV multimodal observations, protocol-level security-policy constraints, and action-level cyber-physical safety within an auditable decision contract. The evaluation set contains 3,024 samples spanning 17 task-taxonomy nodes and 12 metric scoring dimensions, organized around context understanding, multimodal evidence arbitration, degradation-awar

translated_title: MulRobBench：面向安全且符合安全策略的多模态无人机智能体的决策级基准测试
translated_abstract: 在物联网赋能的智慧城市场景中，无人机（UAV）正从被动感知平台演变为信息物理决策者，它们必须在观测退化与语言含糊的情况下遵守运行规则。现有的无人机和多模态基准测试涵盖了空中感知、导航、协作和任务推理，但很少测试在关键决策时物理证据、协议约束和行动风险是否保持耦合。我们提出了MulRobBench，这是一个离线的、协议条件化的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）无人机智能体基准测试，它在可审计的决策契约中将真实的无人机多模态观测、协议级安全策略约束和行动级信息物理安全联系起来。评估集包含3,024个样本，涵盖17个任务分类节点和12个指标评分维度，围绕上下文理解、多模态证据仲裁和退化感知（摘要此处截断）等能力进行组织。
tldr: 该论文提出MulRobBench，首个在可审计决策契约中将真实无人机多模态观测、协议级安全策略约束与行动级信息物理安全耦合起来的决策级VLA无人机智能体基准测试，包含3,024个样本、17个任务分类节点和12个指标评分维度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MulRobBench, a decision-level benchmark for VLA UAV agents that couples real multimodal observations, protocol-level security-policy constraints, and action-level cyber-physical safety within an auditable decision contract, comprising 3,024 samples across 17 task-taxonomy nodes and 12 metric scoring dimensions.
